name: What is the difference between bathroom flooring replacement and a full bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between bathroom flooring replacement and a full bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flooring replacement focuses strictly on tearing out the existing surface, prepping the subfloor, and installing new tile or vinyl. A full bathroom remodel encompasses the entire room, including replacing the vanity, upgrading lighting, rewiring, painting, and undertaking shower remodeling or tub-to-shower conversions. If your plumbing fixtures and cabinetry remain functional and stylish, a floor replacement delivers an updated look with minimal downtime. If layout changes or accessibility upgrades are needed, a comprehensive remodel is more effective.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flooring replacement updates only the floor surface and subfloor, whereas a full remodel covers vanities, lighting, showers, tubs, and layout redesigns.
